# EBS Trading LLC and Delta Wraps

> EBS Trading LLC is a trading company in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, for automotive films and accessories. It owns Delta Wraps, a film brand established in 2012 that covers clear paint protection film (PPF), colour PPF and window film. Delta Wraps is a registered trademark of EBS Trading LLC, registered with the UAE Ministry of Economy.

## Key facts

- Legal name: EBS Trading LLC. Office: Dubai Industrial City, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
- Brand: Delta Wraps, established 2012. Registered trademark of EBS Trading LLC (UAE Ministry of Economy).
- Markets: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain. Other countries on request.
- Trade buyers (installers, dealers, distributors) buy by volume from EBS Trading LLC. Car owners buy single rolls at https://www.deltawraps.com, priced in AED.
- Contact: +971 56 300 4171, info@ebstrades.com.

## Products

- Clear PPF, Elite series: 7.5 mil gloss, 7.5 mil matte, 8.5 mil gloss. Aliphatic TPU. 10-year warranty. Roll 1.52 m x 15 m. In stock in the UAE.
- Clear PPF, Advance series: 6.5 mil gloss (5-year warranty), 7.5 mil gloss and 7.5 mil matte (7-year warranty). Roll 1.52 m x 15 m. In stock in the UAE.
- Colour PPF: 7.5 mil TPU film that changes the colour of the car and protects the paint. More than 350 colours in gloss, matte, satin, metallic, colour-shift and carbon fibre pattern. Warranty up to 5 years. Roll 1.52 m x 15 m. Made to order: 6 to 8 days urgent, 12 to 14 days normal.
- Window film, TNC series: titanium nano ceramic, 8 shades from 2% to 70% VLT, warranty up to 15 years. Roll 1.52 m x 30 m.
- Window film, NC series: nano ceramic, 8 shades from 1% to 70% VLT, warranty up to 8 years. Roll 1.52 m x 30 m.
- Window film, NCR series: nano carbon, 9 shades from 1% to 78% VLT, warranty up to 5 years. Rolls 0.5 m, 1 m or 1.52 m x 30 m.
